How many teaspoons are in 2 tablespoons for measurement in my recipe?
examples.gen:
The conversion factor between tablespoons and teaspoons is 3 teaspoons per 1 tablespoon. Therefore, in 2 tablespoons, there are:

$$ 2 \text{ tablespoons} \times 3 \text{ teaspoons/tablespoon} = 6 \text{ teaspoons} $$

So, there are 6 teaspoons in 2 tablespoons.
